verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's order (badge, logo, product, headline, copy, CTA) and the brand reads clearly, but the headline is too small to lead the skyscraper, the body copy is tiny, and the CTA pill nearly touches the side edges. B gives the headline strong weight, but it shrinks the SOLSTICE logo to an illegible speck and makes the NEW FLAVOR badge as big as the CTA, so the two buttons compete. Its product is small and sits low on a large, arbitrary ellipse.
